exposure: changes in the fetal heart rate
cohort: 439 women who underwent epidural analgesia during labor from October 1, 2020 to December 31, 2020. Excluded were cases of multiples, fetal death, noncephalic presentation, and gestational age at birth <37.0 weeks.
finding: Worsening fetal heart rate category within 60 minutes of epidural administration independently increased the risk for cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The study found that epidural analgesia during labor was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery, particularly when there was a worsening fetal heart rate category after epidural administration.
